name: DragonState
meaning: Dragon +0x270 (SetState table 0x446b53, UpdateState table 0x445e5e). Flying set = Dragon_IsFlying.

name: DRAGON_ST_IDLE
meaning: Anim 7 loop, faces the Wolf. Also the landing point of msg 0x75 and of 0x23, whatever the altitude.

name: DRAGON_ST_FIRE
meaning: Wolf msg 0x35 (burn, WOLF_ST_BURNT) if the Wolf is not dead; anim 0xd; -> 0.

name: DRAGON_ST_INHALE
meaning: Anim 0xc, faces the Wolf. At the end -> 1 if IsWolfInFireReach, else 0.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_FIRE
meaning: Airborne burn: msg 0x35, anim 0x19; -> 0x13.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_INHALE
meaning: Airborne inhale, anim 0x15. At the end -> 3 if in reach, else 0x13.

name: DRAGON_ST_BACK_AWAY
meaning: Anim 1 once, faces the Wolf, retreats at 300 u/s (ZONE-leashed); -> 0. Entered when a non-running Wolf is within 300.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_BACK_AWAY
meaning: Airborne version, anim 0x16; -> 0x13.

name: DRAGON_ST_CHASE
meaning: Walk (anim 1, 600 u/s) or run (anim 2, 1200 u/s, dust) toward the Wolf while he is within 1280. Advances only while dist >= 350.

name: DRAGON_ST_SKID1
meaning: Anim 0xe. Per-frame halving skid after a run; -> 9 when the skid ends OR the anim finishes.

name: DRAGON_ST_SKID2
meaning: Anim 0xf; the same exit test -> 0xa.

name: DRAGON_ST_SKID3
meaning: Anim 0x10; -> 0 when the skid has ended AND the anim finished.

name: DRAGON_ST_IDLE_PICK
meaning: Transient: Rand_Bounded(5) == 0 -> 0xc, else 0xf.

name: DRAGON_ST_IDLE_A1
meaning: Faces the Wolf once, idleLoopsLeft = Rand(3)+1, anim 4 loop; one loop -> 0xd.

name: DRAGON_ST_IDLE_A2
meaning: Anim 5 loop, idleLoopsLeft loops -> 0xe.

name: DRAGON_ST_IDLE_A3
meaning: Anim 6 loop, one loop -> 0.

name: DRAGON_ST_IDLE_B
meaning: idleLoopsLeft = Rand(12)+1 loops of anim 7 -> 0.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_WAIT
meaning: Hover (anim 0x16 loop) facing the Wolf while he is outside ZONE; his x/z in ZONE -> 0x13.

name: DRAGON_ST_TAKEOFF
meaning: flyHeight = 0, anim 0x12; -> 0x12.

name: DRAGON_ST_RISE
meaning: Anim 0x11, climbs up to 160; -> 0x14 if flyToRockZone, else 0x13.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_CHASE
meaning: Anim 8/9, faces the Wolf, hover-chases at 600 u/s (ZONE-leashed).

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_TO_ROCKZONE
meaning: Faces rockZoneTarget and flies there at 1800 u/s, ignoring ZONE; dragon x/z in ROCKZONE -> 0x13.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_TO_SPHERE
meaning: Accepted time-machine call while flying: faces and approaches sphereTarget, ignoring ZONE. Left only by msg 0x39/0x75.

name: DRAGON_ST_LAND
meaning: Anim 0xa; -> 0x17.

name: DRAGON_ST_DESCEND
meaning: Anim 0x14; descends until flyHeight < 0 or a non-Wolf floor contact; -> 0x18.

name: DRAGON_ST_TOUCHDOWN
meaning: SnapToGround(1), anim 0xb; -> 0.

name: DRAGON_ST_WAIT_FIRST_CONTACT
meaning: Initial state: anim 7, faces the Wolf; his x/z in BOXFIRSTCONTACT -> 0x1a. Messages refused.

name: DRAGON_ST_CINE_FIRST_CONTACT
meaning: Cine_Start(CINEFIRSTCONTACT, FLAGFIRSTCONTACT); when g_cinePlayer.active == 0 -> SnapToGround, 0. Messages refused.

name: DRAGON_ST_WALK_TO_SPHERE
meaning: Accepted call while grounded: faces sphereTarget, anim 1, ZONE-leashed approach. Unreachable with the Lvl-09 layout.

name: DRAGON_ST_TIMEWARP
meaning: msg 0x39 while grounded: box collision off, anim 0x17; -> 0x1e.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_TIMEWARP
meaning: msg 0x39 while flying: anim 0x1a; -> 0x1e.

name: DRAGON_ST_IN_TRANSIT
meaning: Inert until msg 0x3a.

name: DRAGON_ST_ARRIVE
meaning: msg 0x3a: collision on, SetPosition(arrival), anim 0x18; -> 0x20.

name: DRAGON_ST_CINE_CHRONOBALL
meaning: Cine_Start(CINECHRONOBALL, FLAGCHRONOBALL); when the cine is inactive -> 0x25. Messages refused.

name: DRAGON_ST_TAKEOFF_TO_SPHERE
meaning: Call accepted during 0x11: keeps the take-off anim; -> 0x22.

name: DRAGON_ST_RISE_TO_SPHERE
meaning: Anim 0x11, climbs; -> 0x15.

name: DRAGON_ST_WAIT_PRESENT
meaning: Call refused while grounded: anim 7, frozen (no AI) until TimeMachine_IsInPresent(Wolf); then 0.

name: DRAGON_ST_FLY_WAIT_PRESENT
meaning: Call refused while flying: anim 0x16, frozen until the Wolf is in the present; then savedState.

name: DRAGON_ST_GONE
meaning: After the CHRONOBALL cine: hidden (0x800), no box collision, no Update, all messages refused. Permanent, survives Reset.

name: DRAGON_ST_NONE
meaning: Sentinel written by Init before SetState(0x19).
